==Description==
'''Legacy Simplicity''', previously just '''Simplicity''', is a community [[Maps|map]] themed around old Roblox games. As it is a community map, it can only be played in private servers.

==Design & Path==
The map takes place on a simplistic grass island in the middle of the ocean. The terrain of this island is mainly moutainous, though there are flat plains on the island and a small beach. Multiple lamp posts, trees and gear givers can be seen across the map. There are two paths on this map, a black path where enemies spawn on the plains, and a grey cosmetic path on the mountains. There are also multiple bridges near the beach. An old Roblox car can be seen near the entrance. An old Roblox house can be seen on the mountains, alongside a wheat field. A set of old Roblox gear givers can also be seen.

The path starts and ends at a cave.

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:Simplicity}}

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Normal|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*It is recommended to place your ground towers in the middle section of the path, as it covers most of the map's path.

==Trivia==
*Multiple references to old Roblox can be seen in this map.
**The general style of the map is based on older Roblox games.
**Multiple old gear givers can be seen across the map.
**A house that is based on the house that appeared in old default Roblox games can be seen on the mountain.
**An old Roblox car can be seen near the entrance.
